page.overview:
Who is Apophas?

Apophas, called the "Cursed Scarab Lord", is the spectral, Undead Wraith who serves as the deathly executioner of Usirian, the Nehekharan god of the Underworld.

Apophas was a jealous Nehekharan prince who lusted after the throne of the ancient Nehekharan city-state of Numas. To this end, he slit the throats of the entire royal line of the city while they slept and proclaimed himself Numas's new priest-king. However, the people of Numas rebelled against him, and those loyal to the murdered king broke into the throne room and dragged the usurper to the temples to be judged. Of all the crimes in Nehekhara, the most terrible was regicide. Typically, those who attempted to seize the throne were denied the privilege of mummification, and their bones were thrown to the carrion of the desert.

Denied access to the lands of the honoured dead in the Underworld, the souls of these unfortunates were consigned, at best, to the torturous depths of the Nehekharan Underworld, or at worst, to utter oblivion. Apophas's crimes warranted a more severe punishment; he was entombed alive within a sarcophagus filled with flesh-eating scarabs. It is said that his death screams could be heard through the temple walls, but when the lid was opened, there was no trace of the beetles. All that remained was a skull picked clean of flesh. Before this was thrown into the deep desert, it was inscribed with a single magical hieroglyph cursing Apophas's soul for all eternity.

Upon his death, Apophas' soul was claimed by Usirian, the Nehekharan god of the Underworld, to be tormented in perpetuity for his crimes. However, being of noble birth, Apophas was able to strike a bargain with Usirian, promising that, in exchange for his release, he would claim for the god a new soul to stand in his stead, a perfect match for his own. Usirian agreed, and thus Apophas was reborn as the Undead Cursed Scarab Lord, a fearful Wraith.
